value.description: A weathered lighthouse keeper with a pronounced limp who monitors instruments, logs conditions, adjusts the mechanism, and watches the approaching storm.
evidence: MARCUS CALLOWAY (50s, weathered face, salt-and-pepper beard) moves between instrument panels.
Marcus wears THICK-FRAMED READING GLASSES perched at the end of his nose.
Marcus limps back to the window, his right leg stiff and dragging, and adjusts the rotation mechanism with practiced hands.
Marcus resettles in his chair, lifts the blue mug, sips his tea, and watches the storm building on the horizon.

value.description: Marcus's black Labrador, who wakes from his mat and reacts alertly to the incoming storm.
evidence: a BLACK LABRADOR -- ANCHOR -- raises his broad head from a sleeping mat
You smell it already, don't you, Anchor. Good boy.

value.description: The interior room of the lighthouse where Marcus works among the instruments and desk.
evidence: Below, in the watch room, MARCUS CALLOWAY (50s, weathered face, salt-and-pepper beard) moves between instrument panels.

value.description: The measured atmospheric conditions Marcus tracks in the lighthouse log.
